did: The www image now carries its own nginx config, with file_host's and the résumé service's addresses from env, so home runs it with no some-ui checkout, and it serves nothing rather than nginx's stock page where its config can't be written. The résumé service is published from CI after one offline render. The render image says it needs render-folders 1 and refuses to publish a malformed label, and www, render and résumé publishes ask the server's release to look. The ledger places the cards-essay store, keeper and video route. The scratchpad essay now covers why nano opens, --refresh past Nix's hour-long cache and reloading tmux, with a test holding it to the scratch README. On the phone, a cards essay on Studio's Renders opens its own page, where Watch brings home's video over and plays it.

left: Watch on a cards essay's page appears only once the epoch-8 route snapshot is on main and home runs server#866; until then the page says home hasn't given the size.
The general coverage check for every cards essay, through cards-check, stays in #3000.
